# Dr. Axe

> > Dr. Axe delivers natural health education and wellness training focused on metabolism, nutrition, and holistic health optimization.

Dr. Axe (Dr. Josh Axe) is a natural health expert who provides evidence-based wellness content through webinars, training programs, and health coaching resources. The site emphasizes nutrition, metabolic health, and natural approaches to common health challenges.

## Key Topics

- Dr. Josh Axe
- Metabolism
- Weight Loss
- Nutrition
- Natural Health
- Health Coaching
- Webinar
- Cellulite
- Free Training
- Wellness

## Featured Webinars & Training

- [How to Master Your Metabolism Webinar](https://my.draxe.com/): Dr. Axe's webinar on boosting metabolism and eliminating cellulite.
